summary_en: 67,700 common shares cancelled (0.6% of shares outstanding excluding treasury). Post-cancellation issued share count: 10,978,891. Effective date 31 August 2026. Treasury holdings after cancellation: 138,947 shares.
title_en: Notice of Completion of Treasury Share Cancellation
translation_en_brief: SINANEN HOLDINGS completed the cancellation of 67,700 treasury shares of common stock on 31 August 2026, pursuant to the Board resolution of 10 August 2026 and Article 178 of the Companies Act. The cancelled shares represented 0.6% of shares outstanding (excluding treasury) at the time of the Board decision. Post-cancellation, the company has 10,978,891 issued shares and retains 138,947 shares in treasury (as of 30 June 2026).
